overview: A postal system for villages: buy a mailbox from the village Mail Person, write to other players with an item attached, and get deliveries, gifts and village news.
It needs Pandorical on the server and on the client; without it you get a chat message instead of a mail screen.

1.0.2: A Mail Person caught by a zombie wears their own zombie look, not a missing texture.
1.0.1: Mail held for a player with no mailbox can be collected at any public mailbox.
Or asked for from a Mail Person. The notice says where it is waiting.
Villagers only write to people they actually know.
A spilt bucket no longer washes a mailbox away.
1.0.0: Letters with an attachment, to anyone who has played on the server.
A notice board carrying the weather and the deaths of villagers nearby.
Donations go to Village Builder's next project.
An unread count sits in the corner of the screen.
Post offices generate with a chest worth opening.
